description: Returns pages of a Vogue Paris issue as images in the original French, up to 4 at a time, for reading and translation into English or any language. Where the site has already transcribed a page, its French text and an English translation come back with it (marked machine-made). Page 1 is the cover. Pages are returned for issues from 1930 and earlier; later issues get the reader link. Example questions: "translate page 3 of the 1 July 1920 Vogue"; "what does this 1925 Vogue ad say in English"; "read me the French on the cover of June 1922".

issue.description: An issue date ("1925-06-15"), a month ("1925-06", nearest issue that month) or a Gallica ark ("bpt6k9604118j")

name: translate_vogue_page
title: Translate a Vogue page
